entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have destroyed Mindwall body but he managed to split his mind into many pieces and taken direct control of the subdued orcs. Destroy the pillars in each level four other levels.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你摧毁了意念之墙的身躯，但他设法把自己的心智分裂成许多块，直接控制了那些被他压服的兽人。摧毁其他四个关卡中的心灵控制柱。#WHITE#

entries.source:
You place the detonator, you have 100 turns to get out or be destroyed by the explosion.
Use your #{bold}##GOLD#Rod of Recall#LAST##{normal}#!
entries.target:
你安置了炸弹；你有 100 回合撤离，否则会被爆炸摧毁。
使用#{bold}##GOLD#回归之杖#LAST##{normal}#！

entries.source: Metash has asked you to investigate the Krimbul Clan, south of the peninsula.
entries.target: 梅塔什希望你调查半岛南部的克里布尔部族。

entries.source: A whitehoof turned mad with power is trying to lead them in a war against Kruk Pride.
entries.target: 一名因力量而疯狂的白蹄族人正企图带领全族向克鲁克部落开战。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have stopped the pitiful Nektosh, ensuring one less threat for the Pride and a future for the Whitehooves.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你阻止了可怜的纳克托什，克鲁克部落从此少了一个威胁，白蹄族也因此有了未来。#WHITE#

entries.source: The giants have breached the mountain-side of Kruk pride!
entries.target: 巨人们已经攻破了克鲁克部落依山的一侧！

entries.source:
You place the detonator, you have 220 turns to get out or be destroyed by the explosion.
Use your #{bold}##GOLD#Rod of Recall#LAST##{normal}#!
entries.target:
你安置了炸弹；你有 220 回合撤离，否则会被爆炸摧毁。
使用 #{bold}##GOLD#回归之杖#LAST##{normal}#！

entries.source: No Fumes Without Fire
entries.target: 无火不起烟

entries.source: The time for revenge is at hand! The Tribe stands crippled under your assaults.
entries.target: 复仇的时刻终于到了！气之部族在你的攻击下濒临瘫痪。

entries.source: Enter the Palace of Fumes and crush their leaders once and for all!
entries.target: 攻入烟雾宫殿，彻底粉碎他们的领袖！

entries.source: For Kruk!
entries.target: 为了克鲁克！

entries.source: For the Prides!
entries.target: 为了部落！

entries.source: For the Garkul!
entries.target: 为了加库尔！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Council Member Nashal is dead.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 议会成员纳沙尔死了。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Council Member Tormak is dead.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 议会成员托马克死了。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Council Member Pendor is dead.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 议会成员潘多尔死了。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Council Member Palaquie is dead.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 议会成员帕拉奎死了。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Council Member Tantalos is dead.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 议会成员坦塔洛斯死了。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have destroyed the Council and shattered the Tribe.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你摧毁了他们的议会，气之部族分崩离析！#WHITE#

entries.source: What is all this noise about!
entries.target: 这是什么声音！

entries.source: Tantalos! What have you done!
entries.target: 坦塔洛斯！你都干了些什么！

entries.source: Hunter, Quarry
entries.target: 猎手与猎物

entries.source: The Steam Quarry is a strategic zone for the Atmos tribe, it provides them with much of their energy needs.
entries.target: 蒸汽采石场是气之部族的重要战略设施，为他们供应能量。

entries.source: If you are to assault the Palace of Fumes you need to cut that supply off. Destroy the three giant steam valves to make the Palace vulnerable.
entries.target: 如果你想要进攻烟雾宫殿你必须切断他们的供应。摧毁三个巨大的蒸汽阀来破坏宫殿的防御。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* The first valve has been destroyed.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 第一个蒸汽阀已被摧毁。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* The second valve has been destroyed.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 第二个蒸汽阀已被摧毁。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* The third valve has been destroyed.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 第三个蒸汽阀已被摧毁。#WHITE#

entries.source: A Ritch Party
entries.target: 里奇派对

entries.source: Our ultimate goal on the mainland is to get rid of the Sunwall once and for all.
entries.target: 我们在大陆上的最终目的是一劳永逸地铲除太阳堡垒。

entries.source: To do that we will prepare a special surprise to help our final attack.
entries.target: 为此，我们必须为最终的突袭做好准备，给他们一个“惊喜”。

entries.source: Go to the Ritch Hive in the mountains north of the Erúan desert and collect a big pile of ritch eggs.  About 30 viable eggs should be sufficient.
entries.target: 前去艾露安沙漠以北群山中的里奇巢穴，收集大量的里奇虫卵。大约 30 个可孵化的虫卵便已足够。

entries.source: When you have enough, find a tunnel leading north and use the special sand shredder gloves tinker to open a path under the Gates of Morning.
entries.target: 当你有了足够的里奇虫卵，找到一条向北的隧道，使用特殊的挖沙手套插件来挖出一条通向晨曦之门的道路。

entries.source: Finally, place the eggs in a protected spot to hatch.  With luck, they will provide a distraction while you later assault the city.
entries.target: 最后，将虫卵放在安全的地方让它们孵化。运气好的话，等你日后进攻城市时，它们能帮你分散敌人的注意力。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have collected enough eggs.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你收集了足够多的虫卵#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have tunnelled close enough to the Gates of Morning.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你的隧道已经向北挖到足够接近晨曦之门的位置。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have placed the little surprise.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经安放好了这个小小的“惊喜”。#WHITE#

entries.source: Stralite Sand Shredder
entries.target: 斯莱特掘沙者

entries.source: Automatically deploy a huge rotating drill when you hit a sandwall, carving out a big part of it quickly.
entries.target: 当你碰到沙墙时，会自动部署一个巨大的旋转钻头，很快就钻出一个大洞。

entries.source: You cannot bring yourself to drop the %s
entries.target: 你无法丢弃 %s

entries.source: Of Steamwork and Pain
entries.target: 蒸汽机械与痛苦

entries.source: To win the war you must help the Pride by striking a blow to the giant's morale and supply lines.
entries.target: 为了让部落赢得和蒸汽巨人的战争，你必须打击敌人的士气和补给线。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have assaulted the Vaporous Emporium, crushing the morale of the Atmos tribe.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经袭击了蒸汽商场，摧垮了气之部族的士气。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must assault the Vaporous Emporium to crush the morale of the Atmos tribe!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须袭击蒸汽商场，摧垮气之部族的士气！#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the yeti cave and vanquished the Yeti Patriarch.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了雪人洞穴，打败了雪人族长。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Yeti Cave and destroy the patriarch!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索雪人洞穴并击败他们的族长！#WHITE#

entries.source: Stargazers
entries.target: 观星者

entries.source: Our ultimate goal on the mainland is to get rid of the Sunwall once and for all.
entries.target: 我们在大陆上的最终目的是一劳永逸地铲除太阳堡垒。

entries.source: Our scouts have noticed the Gates of Morning is being reinforced with sun and moon orbs.
entries.target: 我们的哨兵注意到晨曦之门使用太阳球和月亮球来进行防护。

entries.source: Go to the Sunwall Observatory and destroy everything there to reduce their supplies.
entries.target: 前往太阳堡垒观星台，摧毁那里的一切，以削减他们的补给。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have destroyed the Observatory, the Gates of Morning defenses will be weakened.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你摧毁了观星台，晨曦之门的防御被削弱了。#WHITE#

entries.source: You Shall Pass!
entries.target: 你必须通过！

entries.source: The Atmos tribe is not our sole problem. The Sunwall as grown in strength since the Scourge from the West came and murdered the other Prides leaders.
entries.target: 气之部族不是我们唯一的问题。自从西方来的灾星来到这里并屠杀了其他兽人部落的领袖，太阳堡垒便日益壮大。

entries.source: Our brothers on the mainland lay enslaved, but before we free them you must secure a way to the mainland.
entries.target: 我们在大陆上的兄弟惨遭奴役；在解放他们之前，你必须先打通前往大陆的道路。

entries.source: Go to the sunwall outpost. Show them the wrath of Garkul, show no mercy for they have none for us.
entries.target: 前去太阳堡垒前哨站。让他们领教加库尔的怒火，绝不仁慈，因为他们对我们也不曾仁慈。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have destroyed the sunwall outpost, and secured a way to the mainland.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经摧毁了太阳堡垒前哨站，确保了通向大陆的安全通路。#WHITE#

entries.source: To the mainland!
entries.target: 前往大陆！

entries.source:
The way to the mainland is now clear.
Travel there using the bridge on the worldmap.
entries.target:
前往大陆的障碍已经被清除了。
使用大地图上的桥来前往大陆。

entries.source: Voyage to the Center of Eyal
entries.target: 直探地心！

entries.source: In the Palace of Fumes you found a geothermal vent that digs deep into the planet's core.
entries.target: 在烟雾宫殿中，你找到了一个冒出地热的排风口，直探这颗星球的地心。

entries.source: Strange mutated giants came out. You must find the source of those titans!
entries.target: 奇怪的变异巨人从里面走了出来。你必须找出泰坦的来源！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Travelling deep within Eyal you found the source of all corruptions: the dead god #{bold}##CRIMSON#Amakthel#LAST##{normal}#.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 在埃亚尔的深核中寻找，你终于找到了一切腐化的源头：已死之神#{bold}##CRIMSON#阿马克泰尔#LAST##{normal}#。#WHITE#

entries.source: Mystery of the Yetis
entries.target: 雪人之谜

entries.source: You have found a bit of preserved yeti muscle, probably somebody somewhere will be interested.
entries.target: 你找到了一些保存好的雪人肌肉，或许某处有人会对它感兴趣吧…

entries.source: For each yeti muscle you return to the psy-machines in the ruins of a lost city you will gain a great reward.
entries.target: 你每找到一份雪人肌肉并交给在失落之城废墟的灵能机器，你就会获得一份奖励。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have helped the strange psionic machines and got rewards out of them. You still feel like somehow you did wrong...
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你帮助了那些奇怪的灵能机器，并从它们那里获得了奖励。可是，你总觉得自己好像做错了什么……

entries.source: Yeti Reinforcements
entries.target: 雪人援军

entries.source: You found a yeti mind control tinker. If you can tame 8 wild yetis and send them back to Kruk Pride they can be trained and sent back to you at your request using a psychoportation beacon.
entries.target: 你找到了一个雪人心灵控制器配件。如果你能驯服 8 只野生雪人并将它们送回克鲁克部落，它们便可接受训练；之后你可以通过精神传送信标，随时将它们召回身边。

entries.source: Wild yetis are mostly found in yeti's caves.
entries.target: 野生雪人主要出现在雪人洞穴。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Captured eight yetis (will be available to summon at level 20).#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 抓住了八只雪人（你至少需要20级才能召唤他们）#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREY#* Captured %d/8 yetis.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREY#* 捕获了 %d/8 个雪人。#WHITE#

entries.source: Yeti's Psychoportation Beacon
entries.target: 雪人精神传送信标

entries.source: Call a trained yeti to your side.
entries.target: 召唤受训练的雪人来协助你。

entries.source: Yetis left to call: %d
entries.target: 剩余可召唤的雪人：%d

entries.source: call a trained yeti for help
entries.target: 召唤受训练的雪人来帮助你

entries.source: The yetis are not ready yet.
entries.target: 雪人还没有准备好。

entries.source: Yeti
entries.target: 雪人

entries.source: You extract the psychoportation beacon from the mind controller. Yetis will require some time to train before being usable.
entries.target: 你从精神控制器上提取精神传送信标。雪人需要训练一段时间才能投入使用。

entries.source: Using medical injector with %d%% efficiency and %d%% cooldown modifier.
entries.target: 以 %d%% 效率和 %d%% 冷却修正使用医疗注射器。

entries.source: No medical injector available, values are indicative only.
entries.target: 没有可用的医疗注射器，数值仅供参考。
